status: DRAFT for Codex review. Frozen once cleared: `run_r4.py register` then records its SHA-256 in the family ledger as the primary `variant`, and no run starts before that record is committed.

hypothesis.mechanism: Time-series momentum in USD-M perpetuals: when the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA while price is above its long EMA and both the 7-day and 30-day returns are positive, trend persistence over the next days to weeks pays more than the round-trip cost plus funding. Long side only; the short mirror is a separate family (short_breakdown) and is never claimed here.
hypothesis.regime: any; the rule carries its own trend filter (close > EMA200, positive 7d and 30d returns). The PIT regime label used for reporting and B0 matching is BTCUSDT 4h close vs its trailing EMA200 at the decision time (btc_up / btc_down).
hypothesis.primary_endpoint: sealed forward-holdout episode-clustered mean net R per trade, crypto book, base cost row

contamination.ledger: research_evidence/ledger/trend_ema_mom.jsonl seq 1: window_spent 2021-12-19T00:00:00Z -> 2026-10-05T00:00:00Z (legacy research, M3 pack, Codex ruling 6070934398)
contamination.rule: Every split that ends on or before 2026-10-05 is development evidence only, whatever its name. No parameter, rule, cost or universe choice may be changed in response to any of it (no retune). An untouched claim comes only from the forward holdout below.
contamination.pre_2021_12_19: PIT data 2020-02-03 -> 2021-12-19 is not recorded as spent for this family, but this candidate's parameters come from the legacy research, so it is still reported as development evidence, never as an untouched sample.
contamination.m3_reproduction: The M3 reproduction on legacy-unverified-v1 is an acceptance test of the harness, not evidence; it is ledgered as a development data_access.

data.forward: The holdout lies after the frozen manifest's store end (2026-10-01). It is read only from a forward manifest + universe that extend these two and cite their digests as parents; until then the holdout cannot open.

books.crypto: PRIMARY. Members of the pit-top40-qv30d-v2 crypto book at the decision time (Monday 00:00 UTC ranking, top 40 by trailing 30-day quote volume, listing age >= 30 days, delist and data-gap vetoes as recorded in the universe).
books.gold-commodity: SECONDARY, reported separately and never pooled into the crypto endpoint (owner decision: gold is in the research). Same rule and parameters, ranked as its own book. XAUUSDT uses the gold cost row (PROVISIONAL, its own 4h funding cadence checked, WEEKEND-REFERENCE-GAP label); PAXGUSDT, XAUTUSDT (tokenized gold), XAGUSDT, XPTUSDT, XPDUSDT, CLUSDT, BZUSDT, NATGASUSDT and COPPERUSDT use the commodity row (UNCALIBRATED). Coverage stated plainly: every member lists on or after 2025-03-27 (XAUUSDT 2025-12-11), so all of its pre-forward data lies inside the spent window (development only) and its sample is small; it gets its own EDGE-00 table and is expected to PARK on the sample row until forward data accumulates. It cannot be promoted while its cost rows are PROVISIONAL / UNCALIBRATED.

universe_rule.warm_up: A symbol is decided only once its contiguous closed 4h history inside the opened split reaches the configuration's start index (240 bars max over all configurations, 220 for the primary); a gap restarts the count (never forward-filled). This is the independent warm-up test of plan section 1a; listing age is the universe's own test.
universe_rule.held_positions: A symbol that leaves the universe while held is still read through its View.enter Position capability until exit.
universe_rule.symbol_priority: Within a cycle, closes then entries in ascending universe rank of the latest Monday ranking (ties by symbol).

rule.entry: le at the close of bar i = cross_up(EMA20, EMA50) and close > EMA200 and ret7d > 0 and ret30d > 0; market buy at the open of bar i+1
rule.exit_signal: lx at the close of bar i = EMA20 < EMA50 or not (ret7d > 0 and ret30d > 0); market sell at the open of bar i+1
rule.stop: stop_atr x Wilder ATR14 of the signal bar, from the fill price, floored to the tick; a bar that opens through it fills at its open, else at the stop; slip-v1 on the fill
rule.time_cap: NEW in the PIT prereg (plan section 4 finite ex-ante horizon; the M3 rule had none): a lot still open 180 bars (30 days) after its entry is closed at the open of the next bar (market, taker). Declared before any run; purge uses this cap, never realised durations.
rule.indicators: EMA seeded at the first bar read (pandas ewm adjust=False), Wilder ATR seeded at TR0 = h0 - l0, returns in days converted to bars (7d = 42, 30d = 180 on 4h), cross_up(a, b) = a_i > b_i and a_(i-1) <= b_(i-1); computed over the last 1500 closed bars available at the decision (the live kline cap). Implementation: tools/research/trend_ema_mom.py (bit-parity with newcore/strategy/indicators.py at 45c22df).
rule.book: One book per asset-class book on its own equity: 10,000 USDT start, 1% risk of the cycle's wallet snapshot, max 4 open lots, gross notional <= 3x equity sized on signal close x 1.10, Cairo-day 3% MTM halt, drawdown kill disarmed (rule evaluation). Quantity floored to the step, never upsized; below min qty / min notional = counted refusal.
rule.no_maker: No limit orders: every fill is taker.

neighbour_grid.rule: one at a time, +/- one step around the primary; no grid search, no selection: neighbours feed only the 80% stability row

trials.detail: variant = primary crypto book + secondary gold-commodity book; grid_point = the 12 neighbours (evaluated on the crypto book); baseline = B0..B3. n_trials and the Holm family are read from the family ledger at evaluation time (every earlier record of the family counts), never from this declaration.

costs.model: zb-cost-model/2 (tools/research/costs.py), rows by explicit symbol class, no crypto fallback

rows.crypto: PLAN: VIP0 taker 0.05% per side, signed actual funding at each actual funding time x funding-mark proxy v1
rows.gold: PROVISIONAL: VIP0 taker, own observed 4h funding cadence (checked), own slip c, WEEKEND-REFERENCE-GAP label

slip_cal_v1.target: per-side fill-vs-reference slippage in bps of the fill price
slip_cal_v1.source_series: none: no execution-grade fills exist yet; the fallback applies
slip_cal_v1.fallback: c fixed before any run (crypto 0.05, every other class 0.10); every result labelled SLIP-C-UNFITTED; a later fit happens once on the calibration window with execution-grade observations and is a new ledger variant, never a per-candidate refit
slip_cal_v1.limit_touch_rule: touch = no fill; price-through or ordered-trade evidence = maker fill

costs.delist: exit at the next bar open with available_ms >= a timestamped notice; no observed notice = last archived mark with 5x slippage; forced-exit PnL reported separately

splits.purge_embargo: purge = max(240, 180) bars = 40 days, embargo 1 bar; decisions in [start + purge + embargo, end - horizon]; an episode belongs wholly to one split
splits.notes: calibration = the slip-cal-v1 interval, excluded from all evidence (no strategy evaluation). train is named so only because a plan needs one: nothing is fitted, the parameters are fixed. train and every walk-forward fold are development evidence (spent window or legacy-derived parameters), each reported separately and never pooled with the holdout. The holdout is forward-only (post-freeze), opened once, atomically, with every baseline and stress row.

metrics: zb-research-run/2, plan section 6, per side, per cost row and per book: after-cost expectancy (mean net R, net % equity, PF, win rate, avg win / loss), MTM drawdown + episode-bootstrap MC p5/p50/p95 (10,000) + longest underwater, MFE / MAE / give-back, counts (trades, episodes, month blocks, refusals by reason, exposure, ambiguity), 95% episode-clustered bootstrap CI (gating) + per-trade CI (reported) with seeds, contribution by symbol / year / regime + top-5 episodes + LOSO / LOYO, neighbour table, stop-first vs target-first, survivor-only vs PIT delta, paired baselines, follower tiers 100 / 200 / 500 USDT and RULES-BACKFILLED share.

baselines.B0: 1,000 seeded matched random entries per candidate trade (seed 20261009): same symbol, side, split, PIT regime label at the decision, same hold horizon (the candidate trade's realised bars, capped at 180), same stop rule, costs, funding and universe; drawn from that symbol's eligible decision times in the same split. Pairing: episode-paired, difference = candidate episode mean net R - the mean of its matched draws.
baselines.B1: hold: equal-weight long of the book's members, rebalanced at each Monday ranking, scaled to equal risk (1R = 1% of equity, the candidate's risk unit). Pairing: the same non-overlapping calendar-month blocks, block net R.
baselines.B2: 20-bar momentum: long when close > close 20 bars earlier, exit when not; same stop, time cap, costs, sizing and book. Pairing: calendar-month blocks.
baselines.B3: cash (0 R): reduces to the expectancy row.
baselines.p_value: one-sided paired sign-flip permutation test on the paired differences, 10,000 permutations, seed 20261009; Holm-adjusted over the family ledger's n_trials; ordinary 95% CIs of each paired effect reported beside it (an ordinary interval is never called Holm-corrected)
baselines.mde: the minimum detectable effect at 80% power for the realised holdout episode count is reported with the family size

edge00.sample: >= 60 independent episodes total, >= 30 sealed-holdout episodes, >= 6 non-overlapping eligible calendar-month blocks, per book; else PARK
edge00.expectancy: sealed-holdout-only lower 95% episode-clustered CI of mean net R > 0 (10,000 resamples); walk-forward mean > 0 checked separately, never pooled
edge00.baselines: Holm-adjusted paired p < 0.05 against each of B0, B1, B2 (B3 = expectancy)
edge00.multiplicity: Holm family = every variant, grid point and baseline record of the trend_ema_mom family ledger
edge00.pit: the PIT-universe result itself passes the expectancy row
edge00.neighbours: >= 80% of the 12 one-at-a-time neighbours keep the sign of the primary endpoint
edge00.intrabar: unresolved ambiguity <= 5% of trades and no verdict flip (this rule has one stop and no target: every exit bar is single-level BAR, so the ambiguity rate is reported and expected 0)
edge00.e10_drawdown: PARK-only until GOV freezes a ceiling
edge00.e11_follower: 100 / 200 / 500 USDT tiers reported; PARK only a failing tier; RULES-BACKFILLED periods cannot gate it

verdict_rules.development: Any run before the forward holdout opens (this R4 PIT run included) is development evidence: it can neither PROMOTE nor REJECT. It is reported with every row; a base-row PIT development mean net R <= 0 is flagged DEV-NEGATIVE for Codex, with no retune either way.
verdict_rules.PROMOTE: only on the sealed forward holdout, per book, when every EDGE-00 row passes
verdict_rules.REJECT: sealed-holdout sample row met and the holdout mean net R <= 0 (no positive point estimate in an adequately sized sealed sample)
verdict_rules.PARK: every other failure: sample short, CI includes 0 with a positive mean, any baseline / robustness / neighbour / intrabar / E10 row fails, a cost row still PROVISIONAL or UNCALIBRATED, or a data / rename / delist gap unresolved

stop_condition: The forward holdout window is fixed (2026-10-05 -> 2027-10-04). It is revealed once, atomically, after its end. Fewer than 30 holdout episodes at that point = PARK on the sample row; extending the window needs a new prereg (a new ledger variant). No interim looks.

m3_reproduction.purpose: R4 acceptance (plan section 7): the harness reproduces the M3 kill-OFF rule evaluation on legacy-unverified-v1 before any PIT run
m3_reproduction.target: origin commit 45c22df, docs/newcore/slice/evidence/trend_ema_mom_v1_canary_{base,2x}_kill_off.csv (blob ids pinned in tools/research/m3_repro.py)
m3_reproduction.acceptance: trade for trade: symbol, side, signal / entry / exit time, exit reason, qty, entry / stop / exit price equal; |dR| <= 1e-9; same trade count. Anything else = NOT REPRODUCED and the PIT run does not start.
